title: Unit Credit Windows, Processing Times and Lifetime Limits for First Notice Packs
content:
# Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs — Unit Credit Schedule

Billing operations keeps the figures that bound unit credits on each pack size of the Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs: the windows after submission within which an event can earn a credit, whether a duplicate submission is credited, the lifetime limit on credits and the time within which a qualifying credit is posted.

| Pack | Undeliverable first letter window (calendar days after submission) | Withdrawal cutoff (business days after submission) | Duplicate submission credited | Screening match window (calendar days after submission) | Lifetime credit limit (percent of units bought) | Credit posted within (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| First Notice 50-Unit Program | 30 | 1 | Yes | 0 (no screening) | 5 | 5 |
| First Notice 150-Unit Program | 30 | 1 | Yes | 0 (no screening) | 5 | 5 |
| First Notice 300-Unit Program | 30 | 1 | Yes | 0 (no screening) | 7.5 | 5 |
| First Notice 600-Unit Program | 45 | 2 | Yes | 10 | 7.5 | 3 |
| First Notice 1200-Unit Program | 45 | 2 | Yes | 10 | 10 | 3 |
| First Notice 2500-Unit Program | 60 | 2 | Yes | 10 | 10 | 2 |

## Definitions of the columns

1. **Undeliverable first letter window** — the calendar days after submission within which an undeliverable first letter earns a unit credit.
2. **Withdrawal cutoff** — the business days after submission within which a debtor withdrawn before the first letter earns a unit credit.
3. **Duplicate submission credited** — whether a debtor submitted twice in an open series earns a credit for the duplicate unit.
4. **Screening match window** — the calendar days after submission within which a bankruptcy or deceased screening match earns a unit credit. The figure is 0 where the pack includes no screening.
5. **Lifetime credit limit** — the largest number of unit credits in the life of the program, as a percentage of the units bought in the pack.
6. **Credit posted within** — the business days within which a qualifying unit credit is posted.

## The lifetime limit, illustrated

The limit is a percentage of the units bought in the pack, so bonus units do not enter it. For a hypothetical pack of 200 bought units with a hypothetical limit of 5 percent, the limit is 5 percent of 200, that is 10 unit credits in the life of the program, whatever bonus units the pack also carries.
